entities.summary: Sam J. Tsemberis is a Greek Canadian psychologist and homelessness activist. He founded the Housing First program and the Pathways to Housing organization, and he serves as CEO of the Pathways Housing First Institute. He is also an Associate Clinical Professor in Psychiatry and Bio-behavioral Sciences at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA).
